purpose: A preliminary multi-dimensional vocabulary for classifying research problems and retrieving potentially relevant statistical methods. It is a search aid, not an automatic model-selection decision tree.
usage_notes: Multiple labels may be assigned within a category when appropriate.
Categories may remain empty when information is unavailable or not applicable.
Record uncertainty explicitly; do not force a label when evidence is insufficient.
Do not infer causal relationships or distributional assumptions from variable names or plots alone.
Distinguish observed data characteristics from assumptions and user-provided research goals.

research_objective.description: The primary goal of the research.

explanation.description: Explain or interpret relationships between variables.
explanation.zh_description: 解釋或詮釋變數與結果之間的關係。

description.description: Describe data characteristics, patterns, or distributions.
description.zh_description: 描述資料特性、模式或分布。

classification.zh_description: 將觀測值分類至預先定義的類別。

clustering.description: Discover latent or previously unknown groups.
clustering.zh_description: 探索資料中潛在或未知的群體。

association.zh_description: 分析變數之間的統計關聯。

response_variable_characteristics.description: The measurement scale or outcome type of the response variable(s).

continuous.description: A quantitative variable measured on a continuous scale.

binary.description: A response with two possible categories.
binary.zh_description: 只有兩種可能結果的變數。

nominal.description: A categorical response with no intrinsic ordering.
nominal.zh_description: 沒有內在順序的類別變數。

ordinal.description: A categorical response with an intrinsic order.
ordinal.zh_description: 具有內在順序的類別變數。

count.description: A non-negative integer-valued response representing event counts.
count.zh_description: 表示事件次數的非負整數變數。

proportion.description: A response representing a proportion or rate; record its denominator or exposure where relevant.
proportion.zh_description: 比例或比率型反應；必要時記錄分母或暴露量。

time_to_event.description: The time until an event occurs, potentially subject to censoring.
time_to_event.zh_description: 事件發生所需時間，可能存在設限。

multivariate.description: Multiple response variables are modeled jointly.
multivariate.zh_description: 需要聯合建模的多個反應變數。

data_structure.description: How observations are organized, sampled, or indexed.

cross_sectional.description: Observations are collected across units at a particular time or period.
cross_sectional.zh_description: 在某一時間點或期間對不同研究單位收集的資料。

time_series.description: Observations are indexed sequentially over time.
time_series.zh_description: 依時間順序排列的觀測資料。

panel.description: Repeated observations are available for multiple units over time.
panel.zh_description: 多個研究單位在不同時間點的重複觀測資料。

longitudinal.description: The same subjects or units are followed over time.
longitudinal.zh_description: 對相同研究對象或單位進行長期追蹤的資料。

hierarchical.description: Observations are nested within groups or multiple levels.
hierarchical.zh_description: 觀測值具有群組或多層次巢狀結構。

spatial.description: Observations have spatial locations or spatial relationships.
spatial.zh_description: 觀測值具有地理位置或空間關係。

functional.description: Observational units include curves, trajectories, or functions.
functional.zh_description: 觀測單位包含曲線、軌跡或函數型資料。

survival.description: Data record event times and may include censoring or truncation.
survival.zh_description: 記錄事件時間，可能包含設限或截斷。

dependence_structure.description: Potential dependence or correlation among observations.

independent_observations.description: Observations are plausibly independent under the study design.
independent_observations.zh_description: 依研究設計，觀測值可合理視為相互獨立。

serial_dependence.description: Observations are dependent across ordered time points.
serial_dependence.zh_description: 依時間順序排列的觀測值之間存在相依性。

within_subject_correlation.description: Repeated observations from the same subject are correlated.
within_subject_correlation.zh_description: 同一研究對象的重複觀測值之間存在相關性。

cluster_dependence.description: Observations within the same cluster or group may be correlated.
cluster_dependence.zh_description: 同一群集或群組內的觀測值可能存在相關性。

spatial_dependence.description: Dependence is related to spatial proximity or spatial structure.
spatial_dependence.zh_description: 觀測值的相依性與空間鄰近程度或空間結構有關。

network_dependence.description: Dependence is induced by links or relationships in a network.
network_dependence.zh_description: 相依性由網絡中的連結或關係所形成。

distributional_characteristics.description: Candidate distributional forms or features to assess; do not assign them from visual inspection alone.

gaussian.description: A Gaussian or normal distribution is a plausible modeling assumption.
gaussian.zh_description: 可能適合以高斯或常態分布建模。

bernoulli.description: A binary response may follow a Bernoulli distribution.
bernoulli.zh_description: 二元反應可能服從 Bernoulli 分布。

binomial.description: A number of successes out of a known number of trials may follow a Binomial distribution.
binomial.zh_description: 已知試驗次數下的成功次數可能服從 Binomial 分布。

poisson.description: A count response may be modeled using a Poisson distribution.
poisson.zh_description: 計數型反應可能適合以 Poisson 分布建模。

negative_binomial.description: An overdispersed count response may be modeled using a Negative Binomial distribution.
negative_binomial.zh_description: 具有過度離散的計數型反應可能適合以 Negative Binomial 分布建模。

gamma.description: A positive, right-skewed continuous response may be modeled using a Gamma distribution.
gamma.zh_description: 正值且右偏的連續反應可能適合以 Gamma 分布建模。

zero_inflated.description: The response may contain more zeros than expected under a standard count model.
zero_inflated.zh_description: 零值數量可能高於一般計數模型的預期。

heavy_tailed.description: The response or errors may have heavier tails than a Gaussian distribution.
heavy_tailed.zh_description: 反應變數或誤差可能具有比常態分布更厚的尾部。

mixture_distribution.description: Data may arise from multiple underlying distributions or latent subpopulations.
mixture_distribution.zh_description: 資料可能來自多個潛在分布或子群體的混合。

research_constraints.description: Data, design, or computational limitations that may affect method suitability.

small_sample_size.description: The sample may be insufficient for some methods or asymptotic approximations.
small_sample_size.zh_description: 樣本數可能不足以支持某些方法或漸近近似。

high_dimensional_data.description: The number of predictors or features is large relative to the sample size.
high_dimensional_data.zh_description: 相較於樣本數，解釋變數或特徵數量很大。

missing_data.description: Some variables or observations contain missing values.
missing_data.zh_description: 部分變數或觀測值存在缺失。

censoring.description: The outcome or event time is only partially observed.
censoring.zh_description: 結果或事件時間僅被部分觀測。

class_imbalance.description: Some outcome classes are substantially less frequent than others.
class_imbalance.zh_description: 部分結果類別的出現頻率遠低於其他類別。

measurement_error.description: Observed variables may differ from their true values due to measurement processes.
measurement_error.zh_description: 觀測變數可能因測量過程而偏離真實值。

limited_observations.description: The number of usable observations is limited by design or data availability.
limited_observations.zh_description: 受到研究設計或資料可得性限制，可用觀測值數量有限。

computational_constraints.description: Resources, runtime, or scalability may restrict available methods.
computational_constraints.zh_description: 運算資源、執行時間或可擴展性限制可使用的方法。
